findings.evidence: "Every interactive control has a non-empty accessible name" and "every action is keyboard-operable" restate standard accessibility guidance. Together with the general token and shared-component rules, these create a substantial activation layer alongside the more valuable framework gotchas and evidence-based verdict branches.
findings.fix: Compress the conventional accessible-name, keyboard, shared-component and token guidance into a brief activation checklist. Preserve the label-in-name and target-size distinctions, framework-specific traps, live-region timing, and source-versus-render decision criteria.

findings.evidence: "A fixed preferred width is fine when it is 360 px or less" feeds the source-only pass branch at line 52 without explicitly accounting for the box model. A normal-flow content-box element with width: 350px and 16px padding on each side occupies 382px, but meets the stated width allowance and has none of the listed unresolved cues.
findings.fix: Determine source-only responsive verdicts from the resolved outer box and available containing-block width, including padding, borders, margins, box-sizing and flex shrinking. Explicitly reject the 350px-plus-padding example; require a render when those dimensions cannot be established.
